name: github-release
description: Create GitHub repositories for Agent Skills and release them right the first time: version gate, deterministic host packages, draft-first publishing, published-asset verification and a per-host install log.

interface.shortDescription: Release Agent Skills right the first time
interface.longDescription: Gate versions before tagging, build deterministic packages for each AI host, publish as a draft first, verify published assets against the tested build, and record per-host installs with dated evidence.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $github-release to check whether this skill repository is ready to tag its next version.
